Title: Charge of the Buffalo and combat phases

Messages.Author: ViniFace
Messages.Body:
Hi all,
If I play Charge of the buffalo the combat go straight to strikes or can i play Pre-Maneuver and pre-strikes cards like Drawing Out the Beast, Carrion Crows and Immortal Grapple?

Thank you

Messages.Author: Klaital
Messages.Body: Yes you can, it only skips the manuevers, not prerange (or pre strike)

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
> Klaital wrote:
> Yes you can, it only skips the manuevers, not prerange (or pre strike)
>
Correct.
